name: CorelDRAW
description_en:
CorelDRAW Graphics Suite combines vector illustration and multipage layout in CorelDRAW, pixel editing in Corel PHOTO-PAINT, and font management. Its subscription also includes CorelDRAW Web; a perpetual desktop purchase has a different entitlement set. The CorelDRAW brand additionally covers Go, Standard and Technical Suite, which must not be collapsed into one feature list.

The professional suite is relevant to illustration, brand artwork, signs, apparel graphics and print production. It provides editable geometry, typography, tracing and output controls rather than only filling a template. Plan for installation/authentication, printer-specific checks and any separate AI credit consumption; a 15-day trial is not a permanently free edition.
description_zh:
CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 把 CorelDRAW 的矢量绘图和多页排版、Corel PHOTO-PAINT 的像素编辑及字体管理组合在一起。订阅还包括 CorelDRAW Web；买断桌面版的权益不同。CorelDRAW 品牌另有 Go、Standard 和 Technical Suite，不能把它们合并成一张功能表。

专业套件适用于插画、品牌素材、标牌、服装图案及印刷制作。它提供可编辑几何形状、字体、描摹和输出控制，并非只填模板。需要安排安装与认证、印厂专属检查及独立 AI 点数消耗；15 天试用不等于永久免费版。

core_features.explanation_zh: CorelDRAW 处理曲线、对象和多页排版，PHOTO-PAINT 处理分层图像修正。

core_features.explanation_en: Object styles, multipage views, PowerTRACE and multi-asset export support production workflows; file support does not guarantee lossless round trips.
core_features.explanation_zh: 对象样式、多页视图、PowerTRACE 和多素材导出支持制作流程；支持文件格式不保证往返无损。

core_features.explanation_zh: 套件订阅及维护含每月 2,000 点数，买断仅一次 2,000 点；模型消耗不同。

sections.title_en: Choose the actual product before comparing features
sections.en:
The [family comparison](https://www.coreldraw.com/en/product/family/) distinguishes browser-based Go, Windows-only Standard, and Graphics Suite for Windows, Mac and web. Standard contains Standard editions of CorelDRAW and PHOTO-PAINT. Graphics Suite adds professional color/output control, more formats and the full toolchain; Web is explicitly subscriber-exclusive. Technical Suite addresses dedicated technical illustration and is a separate product. VectorPass and credit packs are also separate offers.

Editorial fit: choose the suite when editable illustration, multipage production and image correction belong in one workflow. A person who only needs an occasional social template should evaluate the learning and licensing burden before buying. Do not assume a Go tutorial or Technical Suite feature is included with a perpetual Graphics Suite purchase.
sections.zh:
[家族对比](https://www.coreldraw.com/en/product/family/)区分浏览器 Go、仅 Windows 的 Standard，以及覆盖 Windows、Mac 和网页的 Graphics Suite。Standard 包含 CorelDRAW 与 PHOTO-PAINT 的 Standard 版；Graphics Suite 提供专业色彩/输出控制、更多格式和完整工具链，Web 明确为订阅专属。Technical Suite 面向专门技术插图，是独立产品；VectorPass 与点数包也是独立销售项。

编辑建议：如果可编辑插画、多页制作及图像修正属于同一流程，套件值得评估。偶尔做社交模板的人应先评估学习和许可成本，不能把 Go 教程或 Technical Suite 功能默认归入买断 Graphics Suite。

sections.title_en: From source artwork to a production deliverable
sections.en:
A documented, illustrative sign workflow is to prepare page dimensions and color settings, import a client image, use PowerTRACE if editable vectors are required, then inspect and refine the resulting shapes. Add type and apply styles; retain a working design rather than treating a flattened bitmap as the editable master. The suite offers reversible effects and layered PHOTO-PAINT correction. Tracing still needs human checks for geometry, text and small details.

For a campaign with several layouts, use multipage view to compare and move objects across pages. The [multi-asset tutorial](https://www.coreldraw.com/en/learn/tutorials/multi-asset-export/) describes creating a list of pages and objects for one export operation. The public text does not expose every dialog option, so no unviewed video steps are claimed here. Review actual exported dimensions, fonts, transparency and the printer’s profile/spot-color requirements. Support for PDF, SVG, AI, PSD or DWG does not establish that every effect or font remains editable in another application.
sections.zh:
一个基于文档的标牌示例流程是：确定页面尺寸和色彩设置，导入客户图像，如需可编辑矢量则使用 PowerTRACE，再检查并修整形状。添加文字和样式，保留工作设计，不把扁平位图当作可编辑母版。套件提供可逆效果及 PHOTO-PAINT 分层修正；描摹后的几何、文字及细节仍需人工检查。

多尺寸活动可用多页视图比较并跨页移动对象。[多素材教程](https://www.coreldraw.com/en/learn/tutorials/multi-asset-export/)说明可以建立页面和对象列表一次导出。公开文字未展示每个对话框选项，本文不声称读过未观看的视频步骤。应检查实际导出尺寸、字体、透明度及印厂的色彩配置/专色要求。支持 PDF、SVG、AI、PSD 或 DWG 不证明全部效果和字体在其他软件中仍可编辑。

sections.title_en: Subscription, perpetual and maintenance are different
sections.en:
The product page offers monthly/annual subscriptions, a one-time purchase and a license with maintenance. Subscription access includes current updates, exclusive features, Web and recurring AI credits while active. Perpetual use is limited to the purchased version and depends on continued OS/device compatibility; future versions require a new purchase. With maintenance, keeping the annual maintenance active provides updates and associated benefits; stopping it leaves the last received desktop version available under its license.

The public HTML returned empty numeric price slots, so no currency amount or universal starting price was verified. The family page says the 15-day trials need no credit card. A trial is evaluation access, not a sustained free plan. Obtain the regional checkout and business license terms for seats, taxes, renewal/cancellation and maintenance eligibility before budgeting.
sections.zh:
产品页提供按月/年订阅、一次性购买及附维护许可。有效订阅包含当前更新、专属功能、Web 和循环 AI 额度。买断限于购买的版本，且依赖操作系统/设备继续兼容，未来新版需重新购买。维护模式在年费有效时提供更新和相关权益；停止维护后可按许可继续使用最后获得的桌面版本。

公开 HTML 的数值价格位置为空，因此未核实具体币种金额或统一起价。家族页表示 15 天试用无需信用卡，试用是评估访问，并非持续免费方案。预算前应取得区域结账和商业许可中的席位、税费、续费/取消及维护资格条款。

sections.title_en: Count AI consumption separately from editing
sections.title_zh: AI 消耗与常规编辑分开计算
sections.en:
The [credit FAQ](https://www.coreldraw.com/en/product/credit-packs/) gives Graphics Suite subscribers and maintenance customers 2,000 credits on the first of each month; perpetual purchasers get 2,000 once. Trial users get 200. Add-ons are separate: the annual add-on supplies 2,500 monthly credits, monthly add-on 2,000; one-time packs contain 2,000, 15,000 or 35,000. Subscription add-on credits reset monthly without rollover, while purchased one-time credits do not expire. These are allowances, not guaranteed generation counts.

Each model shows its cost per generation in AI Generate. Prompt-based creation/remixing consumes credits; the page lists background removal, masking, upsampling, artifact removal, PowerTRACE and Art Style Effects as tools that do not consume them, with edition qualifications. The vendor says projects and assets are not used to train its or partner models; that statement is not an independent privacy audit or a guarantee that generated artwork clears third-party rights.
sections.zh:
[点数 FAQ](https://www.coreldraw.com/en/product/credit-packs/)列明 Graphics Suite 订阅及维护用户每月首日获得 2,000 点，买断用户仅一次 2,000 点，试用用户 200 点。附加包独立计算：按年付的附加订阅每月 2,500 点，按月付的附加订阅每月 2,000 点；一次性包为 2,000、15,000 或 35,000 点。附加订阅点数每月重置、不结转，一次性购买点数不失效。这些是额度，不是保证的生成次数。

各模型在 AI Generate 中显示每次消耗。提示词生成/重混消耗点数；页面把背景移除、蒙版、放大、伪影移除、PowerTRACE 和艺术效果列为不消耗点数的工具，同时有版本限制。厂商表示不会把项目和素材用于自己或合作方模型训练；这不等于独立隐私审计，也不保证生成作品不涉及第三方权利。

sections.title_zh: 安装、浏览器与许可依赖
sections.en:
The current specification lists 64-bit Windows 10/11, 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended), OpenCL 1.2 graphics with at least 3 GB VRAM and 5.5 GB disk space. Mac requirements include 8 GB RAM, 3 GB disk, supported current macOS releases and no case-sensitive filesystem support; Intel AVX2 is specifically required for Painterly Brush. Recheck the full current matrix against the intended machine. Installation/authentication and some content/features require internet. Web lists Chrome/Edge 142+ and Firefox 145+, with limited Firefox support and possible clipboard failures.

The linked [Corel EULA](https://www.corel.com/en/eula/) licenses the software rather than transferring its IP, limits perpetual use to the licensed version, and restricts modification/redistribution. It says product-specific terms and the license certificate determine the governing rights; a BULA may apply instead. Only these general sections were reviewed. Downloadable assets, fonts, AI results and the application are separate rights questions; an output file is not evidence of exclusive ownership of every element.
sections.zh:
当前规格列明 64 位 Windows 10/11、至少 8 GB 内存（建议 16 GB）、支持 OpenCL 1.2 且至少 3 GB 显存的显卡，以及 5.5 GB 磁盘空间。Mac 要求包括 8 GB 内存、3 GB 磁盘、受支持的当前 macOS，且不支持区分大小写文件系统；Intel 的 Painterly Brush 专门要求 AVX2。应按实际机器重查完整矩阵。安装/认证及部分内容和功能依赖网络。Web 列出 Chrome/Edge 142+、Firefox 145+，并提示 Firefox 支持有限、剪贴板可能失效。

链接的 [Corel EULA](https://www.corel.com/en/eula/)提供软件许可而非转让知识产权，买断限于获许可版本，并限制修改/再分发；具体产品条款和许可凭证决定适用权利，也可能改用 BULA。本文只核查这些通用章节。下载素材、字体、AI 结果和应用软件是不同权利问题，得到输出文件不证明拥有每个元素的独占权。
